verses.en: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
verses.fr: Oracle révélé à Habakuk, le prophète.
verses.am: ነቢዩ ዕንባቆም ያየው ሸክም ይህ ነው።

verses.en: O Lord, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
verses.fr: Jusqu''à quand, ô Eternel?... J''ai crié, Et tu n''écoutes pas! J''ai crié vers toi à la violence, Et tu ne secours pas!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ስጮኽ የማትሰማው እስከ መቼ ነው? ስለ ግፍ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ፥ አንተም አታድንም።

verses.en: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
verses.fr: Pourquoi me fais-tu voir l''iniquité, Et contemples-tu l''injustice? Pourquoi l''oppression et la violence sont-elles devant moi? Il y a des querelles, et la discorde s''élève.
verses.am: በደልንስ ስለ ምን አሳየኸኝ? ጠማምነትንስ ስለ ምን ትመለከታለህ? ጥፋትና ግፍ በፊቴ ነው፤ ጠብና ክርክር ይነሣሉ።

verses.en: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
verses.fr: Aussi la loi n''a point de vie, La justice n''a point de force; Car le méchant triomphe du juste, Et l''on rend des jugements iniques.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሕግ ላልቶአል፥ ፍርድም ድል ነሥቶ አይወጣም፤ ኃጢአተኛ ጻድቅን ይከብባልና፤ ስለዚህ ፍርድ ጠማማ ሆኖ ይወጣል።

verses.en: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvelously: for I will work a work in your days which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
verses.fr: Jetez les yeux parmi les nations, regardez, Et soyez saisis d''étonnement, d''épouvante! Car je vais faire en vos jours une oeuvre, Que vous ne croiriez pas si on la racontait.
verses.am: እናንተ የምትንቁ ሆይ፥ አንድ ቢተርክላችሁ ስንኳ የማታምኑትን ሥራ በዘመናችሁ እሠራለሁና እዩ፥ ተመልከቱ፥ ተደነቁ።

verses.en: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not their's.
verses.fr: Voici, je vais susciter les Chaldéens, Peuple furibond et impétueux, Qui traverse de vastes étendues de pays, Pour s''emparer de demeures qui ne sont pas à lui.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእነርሱ ያልሆነውን መኖሪያ ይወርሱ ዘንድ በምድር ስፋት ላይ የሚሄዱትን መራሮችንና ፈጣኖችን ሕዝብ ከለዳውያንን አስነሣለሁ።

verses.en: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
verses.fr: Il est terrible et formidable; De lui seul viennent son droit et sa grandeur.
verses.am: እነርሱ የሚያስፈሩና የሚያስደነግጡ ናቸው፤ ፍርዳቸውና ክብራቸው ከራሳቸው ይወጣል።

verses.en: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
verses.fr: Ses chevaux sont plus rapides que les léopards, Plus agiles que les loups du soir, Et ses cavaliers s''avancent avec orgueil; Ses cavaliers arrivent de loin, Ils volent comme l''aigle qui fond sur sa proie.
verses.am: ፈረሶቻቸውም ከነብር ይልቅ ፈጣኖች ናቸው፥ ከማታም ተኵላ ይልቅ ጨካኞች ናቸው፤ ፈረሰኞቻቸውም ይንሳፈፋሉ፥ ከሩቅም ይመጣሉ፥ ለመብልም እንደሚቸኵል ንስር ይበርራሉ።

verses.en: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
verses.fr: Tout ce peuple vient pour se livrer au pillage; Ses regards avides se portent en avant, Et il assemble des prisonniers comme du sable.
verses.am: ሁሉም ለግፍ ሥራ ይመጣሉ፥ ፊታቸውንም እንደ ምሥራቅ ነፋስ ያቀናሉ፤ ምርኮኞችንም እንደ አሸዋ ይሰበስባሉ።

verses.en: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
verses.fr: Il se moque des rois, Et les princes font l''objet de ses railleries; Il se rit de toutes les forteresses, Il amoncelle de la terre, et il les prend.
verses.am: በነገሥታት ላይ ያላግጣሉ፥ መሳፍንትም ዋዛ ሆነውላቸዋል፤ በምሽጉ ሁሉ ይስቃሉ፥ አፈሩንም ከምረው ይወስዱታል።

verses.en: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
verses.fr: Alors son ardeur redouble, Il poursuit sa marche, et il se rend coupable. Sa force à lui, voilà son dieu!
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜም እንደ ነፋስ አልፎ ይሄዳል፥ ይበድልማል፤ ኃይሉንም አምላክ ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: Art thou not from everlasting, O Lord my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O Lord, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
verses.fr: N''es-tu pas de toute éternité, Eternel, mon Dieu, mon Saint? Nous ne mourrons pas! O Eternel, tu as établi ce peuple pour exercer tes jugements; O mon rocher, tu l''as suscité pour infliger tes châtiments.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የተቀደስህ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አንተ ከዘላለም ጀምሮ አልነበርህምን? እኛ አንሞትም፤ አቤቱ፥ ለፍርድ ሠርተኸዋል፥ ለተግሣጽም አድርገኸዋል።

verses.en: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
verses.fr: Tes yeux sont trop purs pour voir le mal, Et tu ne peux pas regarder l''iniquité. Pourquoi regarderais-tu les perfides, et te tairais-tu, Quand le méchant dévore celui qui est plus juste que lui?
verses.am: ዓይኖችህ ክፉ እንዳያዩ ንጹሐን ናቸው፥ ጠማምነትንም ትመለከት ዘንድ አትችልም፤ አታላዮችንስ ለምን ትመለከታለህ? ኃጢአተኛውስ ከእርሱ ይልቅ ጻድቅ የሆነውን ሲውጠው ስለ ምን ዝም ትላለህ?

verses.en: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
verses.fr: Traiterais-tu l''homme comme les poissons de la mer, Comme le reptile qui n''a point de maître?
verses.am: ሰዎችንም እንደ ባሕር ዓሣዎች፥ አለቃም እንደሌላቸው ተንቀሳቃሾች ለምን ታደርጋቸዋለህ?

verses.en: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
verses.fr: Il les fait tous monter avec l''hameçon, Il les attire dans son filet, Il les assemble dans ses rets: Aussi est-il dans la joie et dans l''allégresse.
verses.am: ሁሉን በመቃጥን ያወጣል፥ በመረቡም ይይዛቸዋል፥ በአሽክላውም ውስጥ ያከማቻቸዋል፤ ስለዚህ ደስ እያለው እልል ይላል።

verses.en: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi il sacrifie à son filet, Il offre de l''encens à ses rets; Car par eux sa portion est grasse, Et sa nourriture succulente.
verses.am: እድል ፈንታው በእነርሱ ሰብታለችና፥ መብሉም በዝቶአልና ስለዚህ ለመረቡ ይሠዋል፥ ለአሽክላውም ያጥናል።

verses.en: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
verses.fr: Videra-t-il pour cela son filet, Et toujours égorgera-t-il sans pitié les nations?
verses.am: ስለዚህ መረቡን ይጥላልን? አሕዛብንም ዘወትር ይገድል ዘንድ አይራራምን?

verses.en: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
verses.fr: J''étais à mon poste, Et je me tenais sur la tour; Je veillais, pour voir ce que l''Eternel me dirait, Et ce que je répliquerais après ma plainte.
verses.am: በመጠበቂያዬ ላይ እቆማለሁ፥ በአምባ ላይም እወጣለሁ፤ የሚናገረኝንም፥ ስለ ክርክሬም የምመልሰውን አውቅ ዘንድ እመለከታለሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
verses.fr: L''Eternel m''adressa la parole, et il dit: Ecris la prophétie: Grave-la sur des tables, Afin qu''on la lise couramment.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መለሰልኝ እንዲህም አለ። አንባቢው ይፈጥን ዘንድ ራእዩን ጻፍ፥ በጽላትም ላይ ግለጠው።

verses.en: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
verses.fr: Car c''est une prophétie dont le temps est déjà fixé, Elle marche vers son terme, et elle ne mentira pas; Si elle tarde, attends-la, Car elle s''accomplira, elle s''accomplira certainement.
verses.am: ራእዩ ገና እስከ ተወሰነው ጊዜ ነው፥ ወደ ፍጻሜውም ይቸኵላል፥ እርሱም አይዋሽም፤ ቢዘገይም በእርግጥ ይመጣልና ታገሠው፤ እርሱ አይዘገይም።

verses.en: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
verses.fr: Voici, son âme s''est enflée, elle n''est pas droite en lui; Mais le juste vivra par sa foi.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ነፍሱ ኰርታለች፥ በውስጡም ቅን አይደለችም፤ ጻድቅ ግን በእምነቱ በሕይወት ይኖራል።

verses.en: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
verses.fr: Pareil à celui qui est ivre et arrogant, L''orgueilleux ne demeure pas tranquille; Il élargit sa bouche comme le séjour des morts, Il est insatiable comme la mort; Il attire à lui toutes les nations, Il assemble auprès de lui tous les peuples.
verses.am: እርሱ አታላይና ኵሩ ሰው ነው፤ በስፍራው ዐርፎ አይቀመጥም፤ ስስቱን እንደ ሲኦል ያሰፋል፥ እርሱም እንደ ሞት አይጠግብም፤ አሕዛብንም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይሰበስባል፥ ወገኖቹንም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ያከማቻል።

verses.en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
verses.fr: Ne sera-t-il pas pour tous un sujet de sarcasme, De railleries et d''énigmes? On dira: Malheur à celui qui accumule ce qui n''est pas à lui! Jusques à quand?... Malheur à celui qui augmente le fardeau de ses dettes!
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ። ለእርሱ ያልሆነውን ወደ እርሱ ለሚሰበስብ መያዣውንም ለራሱ የሚያበዛ ወዮለት! እስከ መቼ ነው? እያሉ ምሳሌ አይመስሉበትምን?

verses.en: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
verses.fr: Tes créanciers ne se lèveront-ils pas soudain? Tes oppresseurs ne se réveilleront-ils pas? Et tu deviendras leur proie.
verses.am: ተረትም አይተርቱበትምን? የሚነክሱህ ድንገት አይነሡብህምን? የሚያስጨንቁህም ይነቃሉ፤ ለእነርሱም ብዝበዛ ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.fr: Parce que tu as pillé beaucoup de nations, Tout le reste des peuples te pillera; Car tu as répandu le sang des hommes, Tu as commis des violences dans le pays, Contre la ville et tous ses habitants.
verses.am: የሰውን ደም ስላፈሰስህ፥ በምድሪቱና በከተማይቱም በእርስዋም በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ስላደረግኸው ግፍ፥ አንተ ብዙዎችን አሕዛብን በዝብዘሃልና ከአሕዛብ የቀሩት ሁሉ ይበዘብዙሃል።

verses.en: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
verses.fr: Malheur à celui qui amasse pour sa maison des gains iniques, Afin de placer son nid dans un lieu élevé, Pour se garantir de la main du malheur!
verses.am: ከክፉ እንዲድን ጐጆውን በከፍታ ላይ ያደርግ ዘንድ ለቤቱ ክፉ ትርፍን ለሚሰበስብ ወዮለት!

verses.en: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
verses.fr: C''est l''opprobre de ta maison que tu as résolu, En détruisant des peuples nombreux, Et c''est contre toi-même que tu as péché.
verses.am: ብዙ አሕዛብን አጥፍተሃልና ለቤትህ እፍረትን መክረሃል፥ በነፍስህም ላይ ኃጢአትን አድርገሃል።

verses.en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
verses.fr: Car la pierre crie du milieu de la muraille, Et le bois qui lie la charpente lui répond.
verses.am: ድንጋይም ከግንብ ውስጥ ይጮኻል፥ እንጨትም ከውቅር ውስጥ ይመልስለታል።

verses.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
verses.fr: Malheur à celui qui bâtit une ville avec le sang, Qui fonde une ville avec l''iniquité!
verses.am: ከተማን በደም ለሚሠራ፥ ከተማንም በኃጢአት ለሚመሠርት ወዮለት!

verses.en: Behold, is it not of the Lord of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
verses.fr: Voici, quand l''Eternel des armées l''a résolu, Les peuples travaillent pour le feu, Les nations se fatiguent en vain.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አሕዛብ ስለ እሳት እንዲሠሩ፥ ወገኖችም ስለ ከንቱነት እንዲደክሙ ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የሆነ አይደለምን?

verses.en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.fr: Car la terre sera remplie de la connaissance de la gloire de l''Eternel, Comme le fond de la mer par les eaux qui le couvrent.
verses.am: ውኃ ባሕርን እንደሚከድን ምድር የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር በማወቅ ትሞላለችና።

verses.en: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
verses.fr: Malheur à celui qui fait boire son prochain, A toi qui verses ton outre et qui l''enivres, Afin de voir sa nudité!
verses.am: ኀፍረተ ሥጋውን ለማየት ባልንጀራውን ለሚያጠጣ፥ ክፉንም ለሚጨምርበት፥ ለሚያሰክረውም ወዮለት!

verses.en: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the Lord's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.
verses.fr: Tu seras rassasié de honte plus que de gloire; Bois aussi toi-même, et découvre-toi! La coupe de la droite de l''Eternel se tournera vers toi, Et l''ignominie souillera ta gloire.
verses.am: በክብር ፋንታ እፍረት ሞልቶብሃል፤ አንተ ደግሞ ጠጥተህ ተንገድገድ፤ የእግዚአብሔር የቀኙ ጽዋ ይመለስብሃል፥ እፍረትም በክብርህ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.fr: Car les violences contre le Liban retomberont sur toi, Et les ravages des bêtes t''effraieront, Parce que tu as répandu le sang des hommes, Et commis des violences dans le pays, Contre la ville et tous ses habitants.
verses.am: የሰውንም ደም ስላፈሰስህ፥ በምድሪቱና በከተማይቱም በእርስዋም በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ስላደረግኸው ግፍ፥ በሊባኖስ ላይ የሠራኸው ግፍ ይከድንሃል፤ የአራዊትም አደጋ ያስፈራራሃል።

verses.en: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
verses.fr: A quoi sert une image taillée, pour qu''un ouvrier la taille? A quoi sert une image en fonte et qui enseigne le mensonge, Pour que l''ouvrier qui l''a faite place en elle sa confiance, Tandis qu''il fabrique des idoles muettes?
verses.am: የተቀረጸውን ምስል ሠሪው የቀረጸው ለምን ጥቅም ነው? ዲዳንም ጣዖት ይሠራ ዘንድ ሠሪው የታመነበቱ፥ ሐሰትን የሚያስተምር ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምን ይጠቅማል?

verses.en: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
verses.fr: Malheur à celui qui dit au bois: Lève-toi! A une pierre muette: Réveille-toi! Donnera-t-elle instruction? Voici, elle est garnie d''or et d''argent, Mais il n''y a point en elle un esprit qui l''anime.
verses.am: እንጨቱን። ንቃ፥ ዲዳውንም ድንጋይ። ተነሣ ለሚለው ወዮለት! በውኑ ይህ ያስተምራልን? እነሆ፥ በወርቅና በብር ተለብጦአል፥ ምንም እስትንፋስ የለበትም።

verses.en: But the Lord is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est dans son saint temple. Que toute la terre fasse silence devant lui!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን በተቀደሰ መቅደሱ አለ፤ ምድርም ሁሉ በፊቱ ዝም ትበል።

verses.en: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
verses.fr: Prière d''Habakuk, le prophète. Sur le mode des complaintes.
verses.am: የነቢዩ የዕንባቆም ጸሎት በመዝሙር።

verses.en: O Lord, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O Lord, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
verses.fr: Eternel, j''ai entendu ce que tu as annoncé, je suis saisi de crainte. Accomplis ton oeuvre dans le cours des années, ô Eternel! Dans le cours des années manifeste-la! Mais dans ta colère souviens-toi de tes compassions!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ዝናህን ሰምቼ ፈራሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ በዓመታት መካከል ሥራህን ፈጽም፤ በዓመታት መካከል ትታወቅ፤ በመዓት ጊዜ ምሕረትን አስብ።

verses.en: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
verses.fr: Dieu vient de Théman, Le Saint vient de la montagne de Paran... Pause. Sa majesté couvre les cieux, Et sa gloire remplit la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከቴማን፥ ቅዱሱም ከፋራን ተራራ ይመጣል። ክብሩ ሰማያትን ከድኖአል፥ ምስጋናውም ምድርን ሞልቶአል።

verses.en: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
verses.fr: C''est comme l''éclat de la lumière; Des rayons partent de sa main; Là réside sa force.
verses.am: ፀዳሉም እንደ ብርሃን ነው፤ ጨረር ከእጁ ወጥቶአል፤ ኃይሉም በዚያ ተሰውሮአል።

verses.en: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
verses.fr: Devant lui marche la peste, Et la peste est sur ses traces.
verses.am: ቸነፈር በፊቱ ይሄዳል፥ የእሳትም ነበልባል ከእግሩ ይወጣል።

verses.en: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
verses.fr: Il s''arrête, et de l''oeil il mesure la terre; Il regarde, et il fait trembler les nations; Les montagnes éternelles se brisent, Les collines antiques s''abaissent; Les sentiers d''autrefois s''ouvrent devant lui.
verses.am: ቆመ፥ ምድርንም አወካት፤ ተመለከተ፥ አሕዛብንም አናወጠ፤ የዘላለምም ተራሮች ተቀጠቀጡ፥ የዘላለምም ኮረብቶች ቀለጡ፤ መንገዱ ከዘላለም ነው።

verses.en: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
verses.fr: Je vois dans la détresse les tentes de l''Ethiopie, Et les tentes du pays de Madian sont dans l''épouvante.
verses.am: የኢትዮጵያ ድንኳኖች ሲጨነቁ አየሁ፤ የምድያም አገር መጋረጃዎች ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.en: Was the Lord displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?
verses.fr: L''Eternel est-il irrité contre les fleuves? Est-ce contre les fleuves que s''enflamme ta colère, Contre la mer que se répand ta fureur, Pour que tu sois monté sur tes chevaux, Sur ton char de victoire?
verses.am: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር በወንዞች ላይ ተቈጥቶአልን? ቍጣህ በወንዞች ላይ፥ መዓትህም በባሕር ላይ ነውን? በፈረሶችህና በማዳንህ ሰረገሎች ላይ ተቀምጠሃልና።

verses.en: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
verses.fr: Ton arc est mis à nu; Les malédictions sont les traits de ta parole... Pause. Tu fends la terre pour donner cours aux fleuves.
verses.am: በቃልህ እንደ ማልህ መቅሠፍትህን አወጣህ፤ ቀስትህንም ገተርህ፤ ምድርን ሰንጥቀህ ፈሳሾችን አወጣህ።

verses.en: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
verses.fr: A ton aspect, les montagnes tremblent; Des torrents d''eau se précipitent; L''abîme fait entendre sa voix, Il lève ses mains en haut.
verses.am: ተራሮች አንተን አይተው ተጨነቁ፤ የውኃ ሞገድ አልፎአል፤ ቀላዩም ድምፁን ሰጥቶአል፥ እጁንም ወደ ላይ አንሥቶአል።

verses.en: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
verses.fr: Le soleil et la lune s''arrêtent dans leur demeure, A la lumière de tes flèches qui partent, A la clarté de ta lance qui brille.
verses.am: ፍላጾችህ ከወጡበት ብርሃን የተነሣ፥ ከሚንቦገቦገውም ከጦርህ ፀዳል የተነሣ፥ ፀሐይና ጨረቃ በመኖሪያቸው ቆሙ።

verses.en: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
verses.fr: Tu parcours la terre dans ta fureur, Tu écrases les nations dans ta colère.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ በመዓት ተራመድህ፤ አሕዛብን በቍጣ አሄድሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
verses.fr: Tu sors pour délivrer ton peuple, Pour délivrer ton oint; Tu brises le faîte de la maison du méchant, Tu la détruis de fond en comble. Pause.
verses.am: ሕዝብህን ለመታደግ፥ የቀባኸውንም ለማዳን ወጣህ፤ የኃጢአተኛውን ቤት ራስ ቀጠቀጥህ፤ መሠረቱን እስከ አንገቱ ድረስ ገለጥህ።

verses.en: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
verses.fr: Tu perces de tes traits la tête de ses chefs, Qui se précipitent comme la tempête pour me disperser, Poussant des cris de joie, Comme s''ils dévoraient déjà le malheureux dans leur repaire.
verses.am: የአለቆችን ራስ በገዛ በትራቸው ወጋህ፤ እኔን ይበትኑ ዘንድ እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ መጡ፤ ችግረኛውን በስውር ለመዋጥ ደስታቸው ነው።

verses.en: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
verses.fr: Avec tes chevaux tu foules la mer, La boue des grandes eaux.
verses.am: ፈረሶችህን በባሕር፥ በብዙ ውኆችም ላይ አስረገጥህ።

verses.en: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
verses.fr: J''ai entendu... Et mes entrailles sont émues. A cette voix, mes lèvres frémissent, Mes os se consument, Et mes genoux chancellent: En silence je dois attendre le jour de la détresse, Le jour où l''oppresseur marchera contre le peuple.
verses.am: እኔ ሰምቻለሁ፥ ልቤም ደነገጠብኝ፤ ከድምፁ የተነሣ ከንፈሮቼ ተንቀጠቀጡ፤ መንቀጥቀጥ ወደ አጥንቶቼ ውስጥ ገባ፤ በስፍራዬ ሆኜ ተናወጥሁ፤ በሚያስጨንቁን ሕዝብ ላይ እስኪመጣ ድረስ የመከራን ቀን ዝም ብዬ እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
verses.fr: Car le figuier ne fleurira pas, La vigne ne produira rien, Le fruit de l''olivier manquera, Les champs ne donneront pas de nourriture; Les brebis disparaîtront du pâturage, Et il n''y aura plus de boeufs dans les étables.
verses.am: ምንም እንኳ በለስም ባታፈራ፥ በወይንም ሐረግ ፍሬ ባይገኝ፥ የወይራ ሥራ ቢጐድል፥ እርሾችም መብልን ባይሰጡ፥ በጎች ከበረቱ ቢጠፉ፥ ላሞችም በጋጡ ውስጥ ባይገኙ፥

verses.en: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
verses.fr: Toutefois, je veux me réjouir en l''Eternel, Je veux me réjouir dans le Dieu de mon salut.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለኛል፤ በመድኃኒቴ አምላክ ሐሤት አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: The Lord God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, le Seigneur, est ma force; Il rend mes pieds semblables à ceux des biches, Et il me fait marcher sur mes lieux élevés. Au chef des chantres. Avec instruments à cordes.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ኃይሌ ነው፤ እግሮቼን እንደ ዋላ እግሮች ያደርጋል፤ በከፍታዎችም ላይ ያስሄደኛል።
